subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Change Management Risks
description: Learn Change Management Risks in one minute.

hook.text: A bank migrates to a new system over the weekend. Monday morning, nothing works. Customers can't access accounts.

buildup.text: Change management controls when and how systems, processes, and policies are updated to prevent disruptions.

discovery.text: TSB bank's 2018 IT migration failed catastrophically. 1.9 million customers were locked out for weeks.

twist.text: The migration was rushed to meet a deadline. Proper testing was sacrificed for speed.

climax.text: Change is necessary but risky. Without proper testing and rollback plans, updates become outages.

punchline.text: Rush the migration. Break everything. 1.9 million locked out.

quiz.question: What happened during TSB's 2018 IT migration?
options: 1.9 million customers were locked out for weeks
The bank doubled its customer base
All customer data was permanently lost
